description: The hospitals, health systems, clinic groups and care companies whose jobs CareJobs.Now reads, most open jobs first, with where each hires, its open jobs and its posted pay. Filter by name, kind of care, US state (employers with open jobs there) or kind of job (employers with open jobs of it). Also lists the AI-training programs and the job boards read, as such.

care.description: Kind of care, one of: 'health-system' (Hospitals & health systems), 'childrens-hospital' (Children's hospitals), 'outpatient' (Clinics, primary & urgent care), 'specialty-care' (Specialty & physician practices), 'behavioral-health' (Mental health care), 'autism-care' (Autism & ABA therapy), 'home-care' (Home health & hospice), 'senior-care' (Senior living), 'rehab' (Physical therapy & rehab), 'dental' (Dental), 'pharmacy-retail' (Pharmacy & retail health), 'kidney-care' (Dialysis & kidney care), 'labs-imaging' (Labs & imaging), 'telehealth' (Virtual care), 'staffing' (Travel nursing & staffing agencies), 'ai-training' (AI training programs), 'job-boards' (Job boards we also read).

kind.description: Kind of job, one of: 'nurses' (Nurses), 'nurse-practitioners' (NPs & PAs), 'physicians' (Doctors), 'nursing-assistants' (CNAs & PCTs), 'caregivers' (Caregivers), 'therapy-rehab' (Therapy & rehab), 'mental-health' (Mental health), 'pharmacy' (Pharmacy), 'imaging' (Imaging), 'lab' (Lab), 'surgical-techs' (Surgical), 'emts-paramedics' (EMS), 'medical-assistants' (Medical assistants), 'dental' (Dental), 'admin' (Front desk & admin), 'allied-health' (Allied health), 'ai-training' (AI training).

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (e.g. 'TX', 'NY') or its name ('Texas').

type.description: 'employer' (hospitals, clinics and care companies; the default without a query), 'ai-program' (programs paying health professionals for remote AI work) or 'job-board' (sources of other employers' jobs).

name: list_healthcare_employers
title: Find healthcare employers
